name: BeHero: Be Your Legend
summary: The game itself is a basic turn-based RPG. After answering a few questions, you are assigned 1 of 6 classes, each with a different ability. The cards, which are required to play, serve as equipment for your character. The rest is pretty standard. You move on an overhead map and try to complete a series of quests. Along the way you will have random enemy encounters which will give your experience point, which in turn will level up your character making him stronger.
